WITH all_assessments AS (
  SELECT a.employee_id, a.skill_id, a.score
  FROM skills.assessments a
),
employee_roles AS (
  SELECT employee_id, job_title
  FROM skills.employees
),
skill_gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    la.skill_id,
    s.name AS skill_name,
    s.category,
    er.job_title,
    la.score AS actual_score,
    rt.target_score,
    (la.score - rt.target_score) AS gap
  FROM all_assessments la
  JOIN employee_roles er ON la.employee_id = er.employee_id
  JOIN skills.role_targets rt ON rt.job_title = er.job_title AND rt.skill_id = la.skill_id
  JOIN skills.skills s ON s.skill_id = la.skill_id
)
SELECT 
  skill_name,
  category,
  ROUND(AVG(actual_score)::numeric, 2) AS avg_actual_score,
  ROUND(AVG(target_score)::numeric, 2) AS avg_target_score,
  ROUND(AVG(gap)::numeric, 2) AS avg_gap
FROM skill_gaps
GROUP BY skill_id, skill_name, category
ORDER BY avg_gap ASC
LIMIT 1
